home.tipSciCell: Schwan equation: Vm = 1.5 E R cos(θ) / √(1+(ωτ)²). Cyan ions drift toward the +Vm pole, red toward -Vm, building the transmembrane potential that drives electroporation. Click to explore in the lab.
home.tipSciChart: Vm rolls off above the characteristic frequency fc = 1/(2πτ). Below fc the membrane fully charges; above fc it stays sub-threshold. The animated dot illustrates the roll-off behaviour. Click to open the Experiment Lab and tune parameters live.

home.loopTitle: The physics simulator that learns your bench.
home.loopSubtitle: Four stages, one continuous cycle. Every measurement you log tightens the next prediction, and the next suggestion.
home.loopStep1Desc: Schwan / Kotnik membrane physics, Pennes-style lumped thermal balance, and Lorentzian capsid resonance solve live as you move sliders: Vm, TI, SAR, DEP crossover, all peer-reviewed.
home.loopStep2Desc: Log real outcomes (target/healthy lysis, viability, PI, transfection, qPCR, temperature) directly from your cuvette via CSV or inline.
home.loopStep3Desc: Two-parameter physics-inversion fit recovers (σᵢ, Vₜₕ) for the Schwan path or (Q, Vₜₕᵣₑₛ) for the resonance path, with proper covariance. Residuals flag drift. Tier badge: Uncalibrated → Drift → Moderate → Strong.
home.loopStep4Desc: D-optimal active learning picks the next (frequency, field, duty) that maximally reduces parameter uncertainty for the active calibration — closes the selectivity window with the fewest bench runs.
home.loopCtaRefs: Every output is a model prediction. Every calibration is your bench. Both are labelled and traceable to their source equations.
home.loopBenefit1Desc: Most simulators cannot tell you how far they are from your bench. ResoPulse scores the gap on every run.
home.loopBenefit1Meta: Fewer bench runs to close a protocol window.
home.loopBenefit2Desc: Active-learning targets the region your data has not seen yet, so each plate tells you the most about where the window actually sits.
home.loopBenefit2Meta: Skip the protocol variants the residuals already rule out.
home.loopBenefit3Desc: Jacobian-propagated TI / Vm bands from the calibration's 2×2 covariance, plus holdout MAE on the ML retrain. No black-box confidence.
home.loopBenefit3Meta: Every prediction labelled, every residual traceable.
